en:
I never touched the cage. Both placing
and retrieving the sickle were impossible.

Such hollow evidence will do
nothing to change that fact.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo's attitude is disconcerting.
But first, I need to counter his argument!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that Kiyo is the culprit!

<CLT=cltMIND>He was in charge of the white cloth—I'm sure
there was a way to get the sickle...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that Kiyo is the culprit!

<CLT=cltMIND>He had a way of getting that
murder weapon, I can prove it!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that Kiyo is the culprit!

<CLT=cltMIND>He had a way of getting that
murder weapon, I can prove it!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm being pushed back!
At this rate, we'll never reach an agreement!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I was so close! I couldn't do it,
I'm being pushed back! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I was this close to pushing them back!
I'll do it this time...I know I can! <CLT=cltNORMAL>
